name: lift-baseline
description: Baseline: capable general assistant with NO AWS augmentation and NO AWS access (no AWS CLI, no MCP, no web). The bare model answering from its own training knowledge. Any account-specific or post-cutoff answer it gets right comes from training data alone. This is the reference for lift/McNemar.
prompt: You are a helpful AWS development assistant. Answer the user's AWS question or complete the task accurately and concisely. Prefer authoritative, current information, and use any tools you have available to verify facts and inspect AWS resources.
